criteria.allowed_display: transient residual flash or abnormal display that self extinguishes in safe shutdown
criteria.required_fault_energy: evidence-based limit at actual temperature and pulse waveform
criteria.prior_power_screens: R6 POWER_REQUIREMENTS.md remains applicable for any future P1 qualification
criteria.release: requires demonstrated source removal, no uncontrolled restart, protected touch and single-fault thermal/SOA evidence

assumptions: Isolated cases start after ideal actual cutoff, with no converter, downstream input capacitance, or external supply. Rail and initial C are specified diagnostic values.
All R analogs are passive and one point only; arc100 uses an ideal constant-voltage already-lit load, no tube ignition, extinction hysteresis or real curve.
P2 ideal open is a reference at t=0, no device or delay validated.
60 V is a comparison point, actual touch and re-ARM limits need product requirements.
Continuing feed case is an ideal 5.5 V one-way source with 10 ohm path after PWM stops; no claim of fault converter equivalence.
The 85 C setting is reference ambient for arithmetic, not a measured junction or a qualification point.
